# Falvey Library

> Falvey Library at Villanova University provides comprehensive research, collections, and digital scholarship services supporting academic excellence across the institution.

Falvey Library serves as the central research hub for Villanova University, offering access to extensive academic databases, digital collections, research guidance, and innovative digital scholarship facilities. The library combines traditional research support with modern digital tools including GIS, data visualization, and digital humanities capabilities.

## Core Services & Collections

- [Falvey Library Homepage](https://library.villanova.edu): Falvey Library homepage supporting research, teaching, and learning at Villanova University
- [Collections Overview](https://library.villanova.edu/collections): Overview of Falvey Library collections, archives, and discovery tools
- [Research Services](https://library.villanova.edu/research): Research services including subject specialists and scholarly publishing support
- [About Falvey Library](https://library.villanova.edu/about-falvey): Institutional overview of Falvey Library organization and services
- [Villanova Digital Library](https://digital.library.villanova.edu): Villanova Digital Library hosting digitized materials and distinctive collections

## Research Tools & Databases

- [Databases A-Z](https://library.villanova.edu/collections/tools/databases): Alphabetical directory of academic databases and full-text research resources
- [Journal and Article Finder](https://library.villanova.edu/collections/tools/journals): Journal and article search tool powered by EBSCO with DOI lookup
- [How-to Guides](https://library.villanova.edu/research/guides-tools/howto-guides): Research tutorials and how-to guides for database searching and digital tools

## Digital Scholarship & Innovation

- [Digital Scholarship Program](https://library.villanova.edu/digital-scholarship): Digital Scholarship Program supporting GIS, data visualization, and digital humanities
- [Digital Scholarship Lab](https://library.villanova.edu/digital-scholarship/lab): Digital Scholarship Lab facilities with Mac Pro equipment for digital humanities

## Library Access & Borrowing

- [Using the Library](https://library.villanova.edu/using-the-library): Guide to library services, access policies, borrowing, and learning spaces
- [Borrow and Request](https://library.villanova.edu/using-the-library/borrow-and-request): Borrowing policies, interlibrary loan, course reserves, and EZBorrow
- [Group Study Rooms](https://library.villanova.edu/using-the-library/spaces/groupstudyrooms): Group study room reservation and booking policies via VenueVU
- [Student Museum Passes](https://library.villanova.edu/using-the-library/borrow-and-request/museum-passes): Student museum passes program providing free access to Philadelphia attractions
- [Library Service Hours](https://library.villanova.edu/using-the-library/access/libraryhours): Library service hours and 24-7 access information for Falvey locations

## Support & Information

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://library.villanova.edu/about-falvey/faq): FAQs covering library access, hours, services, and borrowing policies
- [Events](https://library.villanova.edu/events/event): Library event page template for upcoming events and programs
